content: {"episode_id":"ep-05045","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), acknowledging that prior authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Given the intermittent symptoms and the need to correlate clinical events with arrhythmic activity, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture rhythm data during daily activities."}
